use default

let limit = 1_000_000
let composite = LIST()

for _ in 0::limit do
    composite.add(false)
od

let factor mut = 2

while factor * factor <= limit do
    if !composite[factor] then
        let multiple mut = factor * factor

        while multiple <= limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + factor
        od
    fi

    factor = factor + 1
od

is_prime(value: int) -> bool => value > 1 /\ !composite[value]

let factorials = LIST()
let next mut = 1
let step mut = 1

while next <= limit do
    factorials.add(next)
    step = step + 1
    next = next * step
od

is_erdos(prime: int) -> bool =>
    factorials |> filter(f => f < prime)
               |> all(f => !is_prime(prime - f))

let erdos = (2::limit) |> filter(is_prime)
                       |> filter(is_erdos)
                       |> collect_list()

let below_2500 = erdos |> filter(p => p < 2_500) |> collect_list()

write_line("the Erdos primes below 2500:")

for row in 0..(below_2500.count + 9) / 10 do
    let last = System.Math.min(row * 10 + 10, below_2500.count)
    let cells = below_2500[row * 10..last] |> map(p => "{p,6}")

    write_line(cells |> join(""))
od

write_line("")
write_line("there are {below_2500.count} of them")
write_line("")
write_line("Erdos prime {erdos.count} is {erdos[erdos.count - 1]}, "
           "the highest below a million")
